change_log.note: Read in a browser on 2026-11-04. sicawsaves.org/resources returns "We couldn't find the page"; its Resources link now opens a disaster-plan page; nothing on the site mentions certificates or spay/neuter. SICAW itself is active: (718) 948-5623 and sicawsaves@gmail.com from its own footer are added so someone can ask.

SICAW's site, read in full 2026-11-04, no longer mentions spay/neuter certificates or vouchers, and the page this listing linked to is gone. A listing for a programme nobody can find only sends people on a wasted call, so it is no longer listed. SICAW itself stays listed.
